title: The Yomp Method
author: Louis
desc: **The Yomp Method** is a dynamic continuous program designed to build strength and resilience through a focused three-day training split. Each session targets key muscle groups with compound movements like deadlifts, squats, and lunges, ensuring a comprehensive workout that enhances both power and stability. With a mix of barbell and bodyweight exercises, you'll push your limits while developing a solid foundation for future gains. Get ready to forge a stronger, more durable physique built for long distance load carrying.

ex.note: Farmers carry 60m, reverse sled drag 20m short rest.
Can progress plank, side plank, deadbug
